note: Written by hand on 2026-11-15, before any model run and before the decision table, following rubric.md. Not to be tuned on: prompt and model choices use the d* items (reading) and the items marked op=dev (choosing) only. Each item: the cast tenant writing (null: a number we do not know), the message, the claims a careful reader finds (charge refs resolve against the generated year: kind, month, '#2' the second posting of the same fee, '@1' the tenant's second lease; a list means any of them), flags, and per claim the acceptable actions and the critical ones. 'case_act' applies when there is no claim. Labels are developer-written.
